owner_and_capability: Parent Portal owns its transaction/context/after-commit Runtime port. Root binds the public Tenant Runtime facade; no workflow import of a foreign implementation or public runtime is needed. Partial Refs #4073.
affected_tables: None changed. Existing child relationship checks precede the same tenant unit of work and owner commands.
atomic_cutover: Replace the two production tenant imports in Care and Messaging with the workflow-owned Runtime interface. Root ParentPortalRuntime delegates to the same public tenant functions with unchanged arguments. The old InTenant positive-ID validation and transaction body move verbatim to Root.WithinTenant. The same call sites retain permission checks, context, transaction callback ordering, administrative context masking and after-commit lifecycle. Production and external test construction bind the Root adapter; two internal fixture files use the existing shared TenantTransactionRuntime, extended with the same public-facade delegates to avoid a Root import cycle. Required runtime wiring fails fast in both flow constructors. Owner bindings are built at the existing composition entry point and passed to the config mapper; compose LOC stays flat. No rules, grants, aliases, classifications, exceptions, checker, owner, epoch, Root graph field or setter additions, no budget changes.
tests: Focused full Parent Portal and HTTP suites pass; Care passes after repairing the missing Runtime in two internal fixture files without assertion changes.

Root Runtime tests and full production router golden pass: nested transaction identity, outer commit exactly once, rollback discards hooks, admin tenant masking and explicit context binding, invalid IDs and exact panic text, missing-runtime errors, and synchronous callbacks outside transactions.

Module and hermetic ratchets pass; API and workflow source lint reports zero issues; shared test-support lint, complete non-fast gate, final architecture and immutable-base inventory required before push.

Read-only AST parity preserves 33 existing test files, 308 tests, 1510 complete assertions and 2656 non-import literals. Production AST parity preserves 289 complete functions in 29 files after declared Runtime call substitutions and constructor wiring guard.
